policy.displayName: Algolia search usage above 80% of the plan

documentation.content:
Searches in the last 23 hours are above the pace that would use 80% of the Algolia Free plan (10,000 searches a month) in a month: 260 in 23 h is about 270 a day. At the limit search stops working; nothing is charged. The count is approximate: it comes from the GraphQL operation summary, and Algolia counts on its side. The window is 23 h because alert windows must stay under 24 h.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Buscador-%28Algolia%29).
